figurative_meaning_bn: পোষাকী বা ফুলবাবু; অতিরিক্ত সাজগোজে মগ্ন ব্যক্তি
figurative_meaning_en: Dandy or fop; a person overly concerned with stylish dressing
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা লবেদার, সবসময় নতুন কাপড় পরে ঘুরে বেড়ায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real dandy, always wandering around in new clothes.
Seeing dandies in the office makes me laugh.
history: Refers to colonial-era urban babus who dressed elaborately to mimic British style.
note: This idiom satirizes superficiality in urban Bengali society.
